title.narrative: EU Support for Ukrainian Micro, Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (MSMEs) - top-up

description.narrative: Contract related to: EU Support for Ukrainian Micro, Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (MSMEs) - top-up - The Ukraine Investment Framework is an investment framework aiming at supporting recovery and reconstruction investments in Ukraine, undertaken by Ukrainian authorities, private sector companies, municipalities, state-owned enterprises or other actors. The Ukraine Investment Framework will address priorities identified in the Ukraine Plan and support its objectives and its implementation. It will focus on economic sectors which are identified as strategic in the Ukraine Plan, including access to finance/financial markets, human capital and social sectors, energy, transport, agri-food, critical raw materials, digital transformation, green transition and environmental protection, as well as specific strategic investments and industries. The Ukraine Investment Framework constitutes an integrated financial package supplying financing capacity in the form of financial instruments, budgetary guarantees and blending operations in Ukraine.
